summary.en: A publicly funded health assurance scheme for eligible households. Eligibility should be checked through official channels.
summary.te: అర్హ కుటుంబాలకు ఆరోగ్య భరోసా పథకం. అధికారిక మార్గంలో అర్హతను తనిఖీ చేయండి.
summary.hi: पात्र परिवारों के लिए स्वास्थ्य आश्वासन योजना। आधिकारिक माध्यम से पात्रता जाँचें।

benefits: Health coverage as described by current official PM-JAY guidance.
required_documents: Government identity documents requested by the official enrollment channel
how_to_apply: Check household eligibility using the official PM-JAY beneficiary portal or helpline.
